caption: In the theme editor preview the product page has a Pre-Order badge on the image and a Pre-Order button, after we saved the app embed. No order was placed. The store name is hidden.
One pre-order on one test product took about 4 minutes: experience Pre-order (Copy), start 17/11/26, no end date, status Pre-order Active. The store name is hidden.
Billing has two versions. CORE covers pre-order, back in stock and split payments; PRO adds markets, storewide automation and charge on fulfillment. The store name is hidden.

CORE plans: Free for 20 orders a month, Flexible at $5 a month for 10 orders plus $0.20 per extra order, Fixed at $23 for unlimited orders. Black Friday takes 90% off month one. The store name is hidden.
Shopify's approval screen for Flexible: $0.50 due 17 Nov, then $5, plus usage charges up to a limit of $1,000 per 30 days. We approved nothing. The store name is hidden.
